scantool.ptxt: As the data values are standard values estimated on the basis of values obtained from the normally operating vehicles using a scan tool, use them as reference values. Even when the vehicle is in good condition, there may be cases where the checked value does not fall within each specified data range. Therefore, judgment as abnormal should not be made depending on these data alone.

Also, conditions that can be checked by the scan tool are those detected by ECM and output from ECM as commands and there may be cases where the engine or actuator is not operating (in the condition) as indicated by the scan tool. Use a timing light to check the ignition timing.

item.ptxt: If communication between SUZUKI scan tool and ECM is not possible, perform the following checks:
Check communication condition between PC and VCI using SUZUKI scan tool function.
Check DLC power circuit and ground circuit.
Check DLC cable. If necessary, check DLC cable by substituting a known-good DLC cable.
Check CAN communication circuit and connectors between DLC and central gateway control module. (Refer to “Diagnosis flow: [a]” in Troubleshooting for Lost Communication:K12D Model .)
Check CAN communication system. (“Control Module Communication Bus Off” is detected in any control module.)
Check ECM power circuit and ground circuit.
With the generic scan tool, only data with asterisk (*) in the following table can be read.

When checking data with engine running at idle or racing, place gear shift lever in Neutral position and apply parking brake (M/T model) or place select lever P range and apply parking brake fully. Also, if nothing or “no load” is indicated, turn off A/C, all electric loads, P/S and all the other switches.
Data with asterisk 1 (*1) in the table below are applicable to M/T model.
Data with asterisk 2 (*2) in the table below are applicable to CVT model.

topic.title: Engine Oil Temperature (°C, °F)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the oil temperature detected by oil pressure and temperature sensor.

topic.title: Fuel System A status (OL/OL-Drive/OL-Fault/CL/CL-Fault)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of A/F feedback control by ECM.

item.ptxt: Open loop
Fuel injection time (volume) in the various engine states is determined beforehand. Therefore, information from A/F sensor is not reflected in fuel injection control.
Closed loop

Information from A/F sensor is reflected in fuel injection control. When ECM judges that actual air-fuel ratio is higher than stoichiometric air-fuel ratio, ECM controls to increase the volume of fuel. On the contrary, when the actual air fuel ratio is lower than stoichiometric air fuel ratio, ECM controls to decrease the volume of fuel.

topic.title: Short Term Fuel Trim (%)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates short term fuel trim value (short term air/fuel mixture correction factor) and changes the value corresponding to driving conditions. 0 (zero) indicates no correction, a value greater than 0 indicates enrichment correction, and a value less than 0 indicates enleanment correction.

topic.title: Long Term Fuel Trim (%)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates a median value of short term trim learned in A/F feedback control (closed loop). This median value is used by ECM to correct fuel injection volume appropriately in open loop control avoiding interference caused by individual difference and aging. 0 (zero) indicates no correction, a value greater than 0 indicates enrichment correction, and a value less than 0 indicates enleanment correction.

topic.title: Total Fuel Trim (%)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the comprehensive fuel trim computed based on short term and long term fuel trim.

topic.title: Inj Pulse Width (msec)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the injector drive pulse width (time) during which the injector valve stays open as commanded by ECM. (For multipoint fuel injection, the injector drive time means that of the No.1 cylinder.)

topic.title: Ignition Advance (°CA)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the ignition timing of No.1 cylinder commanded by ECM. The actual ignition timing should be checked using a timing light.

topic.title: Desired Idle (rpm)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the target engine idle speed requested by ECM.

attention3.ptxt: When performing “Fixed Spark” in “Active Test”, actual engine idle speed may not follow the target engine idle speed.

topic.title: Calculated Load (%)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates calculated engine load in percent. The load is calculated based on input signals to ECM from various engine sensors.

topic.title: Engine Speed (rpm)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the engine speed calculated by ECM based on input signal of CKP sensor.

topic.title: MAF (g/sec)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the total mass of air entering intake manifold measured by MAF sensor.

topic.title: MAP (kPa)

topic.title: Intake Air Temperature 2 (°C, °F)

topic.title: Charge Request 6 (False/True)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of ECM charge request based on discharge level of the lead-acid battery.

topic.title: Charge Request 7 (False/True)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of ECM charge request based on discharge level of the lead-acid battery.

topic.title: Charge Request 8 (False/True)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of ECM charge request based on discharge level of the lead-acid battery.

topic.title: Additional charge request (False/True)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of lead-acid battery charge request from other control module to ECM.

topic.title: DTC Condition for A-STOP Inhibition (Auxiliary power module) (False/True)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of DTC in engine auto stop control or ISG control detected by auxiliary power module (lithium-ion battery).

topic.title: Li Battery High Temperature Status (False/True)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of auxiliary power module (lithium-ion battery) temperature.

topic.title: Li Battery Low Temperature Status (False/True)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of auxiliary power module (lithium-ion battery) temperature.

topic.title: Relay “2P” Request (False/True)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates relay “2P” drive request from ECM to auxiliary power module (lithium-ion battery) for engine auto restart or deceleration energy regeneration.

topic.title: Relay “3P” Request (False/True)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates relay “3P” drive request from ECM to auxiliary power module (lithium-ion battery) for engine power assist control.

topic.title: Relay “2S” Request (False/True)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates relay “2S” drive request from ECM to auxiliary power module (lithium-ion battery) for engine auto restart control.

topic.title: Relay “3S” Request (False/True)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates relay “3S” drive request from ECM to auxiliary power module (lithium-ion battery) for power supply from lithium-ion battery to engine / body electrical components.

topic.title: Relay “2P” Status (ON / OFF)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of relay “2P” in auxiliary power module (lithium-ion battery).

topic.title: Relay “3P” Status (ON / OFF)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of relay “3P” in auxiliary power module (lithium-ion battery).

topic.title: Relay “2S” Status (ON / OFF)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of relay “2S” in auxiliary power module (lithium-ion battery).

topic.title: Relay “3S” Status (ON / OFF)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of relay “3S” in auxiliary power module (lithium-ion battery).

topic.title: Auxiliary Power Module Status (A-STOP) (TRUE/FALSE)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of permission by auxiliary power module (lithium-ion battery) for engine auto stop control.

topic.title: Auxiliary Power Module Status (Regeneration) (TRUE/FALSE)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of permission by auxiliary power module (lithium-ion battery) for regenerating deceleration energy.

topic.title: Auxiliary Power Module Status (Motor Assist) (TRUE/FALSE)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of permission by auxiliary power module (lithium-ion battery) for engine power assist control.

topic.title: ABS / ESP® Status for ISG (Failure/Inhibit/Backup Disconnect/Normal)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of control on ESP® control module.

topic.title: Starter Inhibition Request (ABS / ESP®) (TRUE/ FALSE)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of starting motor stop request from ESP® control module.

topic.title: DTC Condition for A-STOP Inhibition (ISG) (TRUE/FALSE)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of DTC in engine auto stop control or ISG control detected by ISG.

topic.title: DTC Condition for A-STOP Inhibition (ABS / ESP®) (TRUE/FALSE)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of DTC in engine auto stop control or ISG control detected by ESP® control module.

topic.title: DTC Condition for A-STOP Inhibition (TCM) (TRUE/ FALSE)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of DTC in engine auto stop control or ISG control detected by TCM.

topic.title: Auto Stop System Request (No Request/Auto Stop Inhibit Request/Auto Start Request/Auto Start Inhibit Request)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of ECM request for ENG A-STOP system.

topic.title: Stop A-STOP Permission (TCM) (False/True)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of permission by TCM for execution of engine auto stop control while vehicle is stationary.

topic.title: Coast Stop Enable (TCM) (False/True)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of permission by TCM for execution of engine auto stop control while decelerating.

topic.title: Idle Stop Maintain Request (False/True)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of inhibition request for engine auto restart control from TCM to ECM.

topic.title: Stop A-STOP Permission (ABS/ESP®) (True/False)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of permission by ESP® control module for execution of engine auto stop control.

topic.title: Stop A-STOP Permission (BMS) (True/False)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of permission by auxiliary power module (lithium-ion battery) for execution of engine auto stop control.

topic.title: Engine Stop Request (False/True)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of permission by ECM for execution of engine auto stop control.

topic.title: DTC Condition for A-STOP Inhibition (ECM) (TRUE/FALSE)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of DTC in engine auto stop control or ISG control detected by ECM.

topic.title: ENG A-STOP OFF Switch Condition (TRUE/FALSE)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of ENG A-STOP OFF switch for execution of engine auto stop control.

topic.title: Hood Switch Condition (TRUE/FALSE)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of hood latch switch for execution of engine auto stop control.

topic.title: Seat Belt / Door Condition (TRUE/ FALSE)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of seat belt buckle switch and front door switch (driver side) for execution of engine auto stop control.

topic.title: ISG Condition (False/True)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of ISG for execution of engine auto stop control.

topic.title: HVAC Demand Condition (TRUE/FALSE)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of inhibition request by BCM for engine auto stop control.

topic.title: ABS / ESP® Demand Condition (TRUE/FALSE)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of inhibition request by ESP® control module for engine auto stop control.

topic.title: Brake Booster Condition (TRUE/FALSE)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of brake booster negative pressure for execution of engine auto stop control.

topic.title: Full Braking (ON/OFF)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the detected state of full braking.

topic.title: BMS Condition (TRUE/FALSE)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of auxiliary power module (lithium-ion battery) for execution of engine auto stop control.

topic.title: Engine Start Request 2 (TRUE/FALSE)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of engine auto restart request from auxiliary power module (lithium-ion battery) when the module detects poorly charged level of the battery in the module.

topic.title: Battery Condition (TRUE/FALSE)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of lead-acid battery charge for execution of engine auto stop control.

topic.title: Battery Temperature Condition (TRUE/FALSE)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of estimated lead-acid battery temperature for execution of engine auto stop control.

topic.title: ECT Condition (TRUE/FALSE)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of engine coolant temperature for execution of engine auto stop control.

topic.title: Accel Pedal Condition (TRUE/FALSE)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of accelerator pedal position for execution of engine auto stop control.

topic.title: Shift Position Condition (True/False)
topic.ptxt: True: Gear position is “Drive”.
False: Gear position is “Parking”.

topic.title: Clutch Switch Enable Permission (True/False)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of CPP No.1/No.2 switch for execution of engine auto stop control.

topic.title: Master Cylinder Pressure Condition (A-STOP) (True/False)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of master cylinder pressure for execution of engine auto stop control.

topic.title: Brake Stroke Sensor Condition (True/False)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of brake stroke sensor for execution of engine auto stop control.

topic.title: Brake Switch Condition (TRUE/FALSE)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of brake switch for execution of engine auto stop control.

topic.title: ESP® Condition (TRUE/FALSE)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of ESP® control module for execution of engine auto stop control.

topic.title: Speed History Condition (A-STOP) (TRUE/FALSE)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of engine auto stop while vehicle is stationary permission based on vehicle running speed after the previous engine auto stop.

topic.title: Tilt Angle Condition (A-STOP) (TRUE/FALSE)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of tilt angle for execution of engine auto stop control while vehicle is stationary.

topic.title: TCM Demand Condition (A-STOP) (TRUE/FALSE)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of inhibition request by TCM for engine auto stop control while vehicle is stationary.

topic.title: Speed History Condition (Deceleration) (TRUE/ FALSE)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of permission on vehicle running history for execution of engine auto stop control while decelerating.

topic.title: Tilt Angle Condition (Deceleration) (TRUE/ FALSE)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of tilt angle for execution of engine auto stop control while decelerating.

topic.title: TCM Demand Condition (Deceleration) (TRUE/ FALSE)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of inhibition request by TCM for engine auto stop control while decelerating.

topic.title: Assist Request (True/False)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of engine power assist control by ECM.

topic.title: Assist Permit from BMS (TRUE/FALSE)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of permission by lithium-ion battery for engine power assist control.

topic.title: Regeneration Permit Signal (TRUE/FALSE)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of permission by ECM for deceleration energy regeneration.

topic.title: Lock-up (Unlocked/Controlled Slip/Transitioning/ Locked)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of the CVT lock-up control by TCM.
